pages.title: Hiking Boots
pages.text: Every explorer needs a good pair of boots.$(br)$(thing)Hiking Boots$() allow you to:$(li)Quickly walk through shrubbery.$(li)Obtain a minor speed boost.$(li)Obtain a minor increase in safe fall height.$(li)Auto-walk up blocks, enabled with $(item)$(k:sns.key.stepUpToggle)$()

pages.title: Safety Boots
pages.text: Various steels can be integrated into your hiking boots to give them an increase in protection. $(thing)Blue and Red Steel$() hiking boots provide additional environmental protection from extreme temperatures.

pages.title: Canes
pages.text: $(thing)Walking Canes$() provide a similar effect to hiking boots but must be held in the hand. Their step height effect can even stack with hiking boots, allowing you to auto-step up even 2-block tall walls.

pages.title: Snowshoes
pages.text: When worn on the feet, $(thing)Snowshoes$() remove the slowdown penalty when walking on snow and allow you to travel on powdered snow.

pages.title: Snorkel
pages.text: When worn on the face, a $(thing)Snorkel$() allows you to breathe for an extra $(item)15 seconds$() underwater.

pages.title: Flippers
pages.text: When worn on the feet, $(thing)Flippers$() improves your agility and speed when swimming underwater.

pages.title: Diving Suit
pages.text: The $(item)Copper Diving Helmet and Backtank$() allow the wearer to stay underwater indefinitely until the backtank runs out of air. You can refill the tank by supplying it with $(thing)mechanical power$(). Wearing $(item)Copper Diving Boots$() allows you to move better on the ocean floor and prevents $(thing)mechanical belts$() and $(thing)lighter-than-air gases$() from effecting you.

pages.title: Lava Diving Suit
pages.text: The $(thing)Blue Steel Diving Suit$() works similarly to the $(l:logistics/exploration_gear#diving_suit)Diving Suit$() but instead of allowing you to breath underwater, it allows you to breath under lava. To work, the whole set must be worn to protect you from the intense heat.

pages.title: Digger Helmets
pages.text: $(thing)Digger Helmets$() provide a permanent ambient lightsource around the player thanks to the candle on your head. They also come with some helpful modifier upgrades such as the $(item)Mining Speed Modifier$(), $(item)Auto Drink Modifier$(), or the $(thing)Temperature Insulation Linings$().

pages.title: Grappling Hook
pages.text: The $(thing)Grappling Hook$() fires off a line of rope with $(item)$(k:key.attack)$() and anchors against blocks to let you swing around and traverse vertically very quickly. You can craft the grappling hook with various items to upgrade it.

pages.title: Harpoon
pages.text: The $(thing)Harpoon$() is very similar to the $(l:logistics/exploration_gear#grappling_hook)Grappling Hook$() but is much more restrictive, having no upgrades and being able to only be launched straight upwards with $(item)$(k:key.use)$(). However, It does allow you to directly ascend up the rope with $(item)$(k:key.jump)$().
